overview_description.description:
Azuki Systems began with a single premise: to be the best multi-screen video delivery platform. To reach this goal they focused on hiring the best people, building the best technologies for multi-screen video delivery and monetization, and striving to always be building what’s next. Their culture of innovation fosters creative solutions to the most pressing problems faced by their customers, and the result is nothing less than amazing. Azuki developed the highest quality, most flexible, best-protected and most proven managed OTT optimized multi-screen video delivery solution available.

Their team is composed of the best leaders, engineers, designers, and technologists in the TV Everywhere, OTT multi-screen video business.
Azuki is the only multi-screen video delivery technology built from the ground-up for the unique challenges of mobile and OTT multi-screen.
They focus on the challenges of their customers: cable operators, IPTV providers, mobile network operators, content owners and enterprises. Your multi-screen problems are their focus.
You can trust that their team, hand-picked, vetted, and proven, is building and supporting the best multi-screen video delivery platform in the world to move your business forward.

about_short_description.short_description: Azuki Systems provides a multi-screen video platform that helps service providers and enterprises capitalize on mobile devices.

product.name: Azuki Next-Generation TV Everywhere Solution
product.description: A platform that enables service providers and content owners to deliver high-quality, protected video content across multiple devices and screens, with options for monetization and personalized user experiences.

product.name: Azuki Media Platform
product.description: A comprehensive solution for delivering premium, protected content to any device over any network, supporting live and on-demand video, adaptive streaming, and digital rights management.

product.name: Azuki MSO Solution
product.description: A solution designed to help cable operators transition from QAM to IP video, reclaim bandwidth, and offer advanced services and TV Everywhere capabilities.

product.name: Azuki Partner Program
product.description: A program that allows technology, reseller, and professional services organizations to collaborate with Azuki Systems to deliver TV Everywhere services and experiences.
